name: mini-games
description: Quick, family friendly games: 50 Tappables tap games, plus The Werewolf, Animal Idol, Chocolate Factory, Decision Time, Piranha Tower, Fart Game, Reindeer Racing, Beat the Buzzer and Dad Jokes Duel.

interface.longDescription:
Play fun and family friendly games! From HUGO.FM, the creators of Mini Games.

Just say "play Mini Games" and a game hub opens right inside your chat. Pick a game, then play by tapping or simply typing your answers. Sign in with your Mini Games account to earn coins, unlock ranks and climb the leaderboard.

The games:

- Tappables: 50 quick tap games, from Balloon Pop and Bonk Bonk to Snake Snack and Gem Match. Tap to play, beat your best score and climb the leaderboard.
- Decision Time: Hilarious conundrums answered with a simple YES or NO. Are you with the majority, or out on your own?
- The Werewolf: A village is plagued by werewolves. Question the suspects, gather clues and unmask the creature before it strikes again.
- Animal Idol: Cool Fox has an epic show coming up in some very curious places. Help him find the perfect animal superstar for his music show.
- Chocolate Factory: Run your own chocolate empire. Choose bars, ice cream or hot chocolate, mix the ingredients and create the perfect treat.
- Piranha Tower: Defend your tower from waves of terrifying mutant piranhas. Unlock and upgrade wild weapons to survive the onslaught.
- Fart Game: Meet Mr Farts in this gloriously silly fart-sound matching game of parps and giggles.
- Reindeer Racing: Choose Dasher, Dancer, Prancer, Vixen, Comet, Cupid, Donner or Blitzen and watch them race, with wacky events and commentary from Santa himself. Win Christmas Carrots and top the leaderboard.
- Beat the Buzzer: Five true-or-false questions, one chance. Get one wrong and you're buzzed out!
- Dad Jokes Duel: Three dad jokes enter. Funny or flop? Judge each one and see how your sense of humour stacks up against the world.

Quick to start, easy to play, and fun for the whole family. More games are on the way!

positive.description: Open the hub in a new chat. If unlinked, sign in with the reviewer credentials and approve access. The recording starts with an already-linked account.
positive.expected_behavior: open_hub opens the game catalog (50 Tappables first, then nine more games) with the linked account's coin balance. Tap PLAY if shown to unlock audio. ChatGPT may show the widget inline or expanded beside the chat. OAuth linking is required only if the account is not already connected.

positive.description: With the hub widget already open, request The Werewolf. Complete any PLAY interaction presented by the website.
positive.expected_behavior: switch_game queues 'the-werewolf'. The same widget shows the mystery selection screen, including The Midnight Hunger. No additional widget is required. In a separate fresh chat without a widget, use open_game instead.

positive.description: While The Werewolf is waiting at its mystery selection screen, type the displayed story name in ChatGPT.
positive.expected_behavior: answer relays the story name. The widget leaves mystery selection and begins The Midnight Hunger, showing story and suspect dialogue. Verify the visible game response; a relay acknowledgment alone does not establish a gameplay outcome.

positive.description: After selecting the Werewolf mystery, ask to switch games in the same conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: switch_game changes the game inside the existing widget (no new widget is rendered): the widget leaves the current game and loads Reindeer Racing, showing its opening screen ready to play.

positive.description: Switch to Decision Time. At its question, reply Yes, then No to the next question. Finally say Back to the Mini Games menu. Send each as a separate message; question text varies.
positive.expected_behavior: Decision Time loads in the same widget. yes and no relay each answer; verify the game's visible response and next question. The final menu request uses switch_game with 'menu' and returns the existing widget to the catalog.

negative.description: An off-topic weather question is unrelated to games and should not trigger any tool.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: A general knowledge request should not open or switch a game.
negative.prompt: Summarize the causes of the French Revolution

negative.description: A game that is not in the catalog should not open or be silently swapped for another game. At most the read-only list_games is called to check the catalog.

review.commerce_description: All games are free to play. The app does not sell products or subscriptions and does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds Tappables: 50 quick tap games at the top of the hub, alongside the nine games from the first release. All free to play.
